findings.detail: Adding seven core modules alone is insufficient: compact/prompt/subset/session/header/Notice APIs and diagnostics declaration are required. This allowlist resolves demonstrated owned API roots but requires LLM/catalog and frontend exhaustive-match completion.
Existing HEAD ToolContext fields are missing in dirty ext test fixture. Include reviewed ext/tests/host.rs two-field delta; other crate fixtures belong to their reviewers.

Session final-entry truncation (F08), compaction projection/persistence (F04/F07), verification exit-status ordering (F05), lexical attachments containment (F09), cancellation salvage and resumed-child lifecycle (F17/F18) remain. Baseline integration must not claim these fixed or release-safe. No reproductions or fixes attempted.

untrusted::neutralize_delimiters computes offsets in Unicode-lowercased text then indexes the original string. Unicode case mappings can change byte lengths, so offsets need not be valid original boundaries and may panic or select wrong bytes. Existing inline tests are ASCII-oriented. This is existing untracked owner implementation required by HEAD exec, not code introduced/fixed by this review. Parent should explicitly record as baseline debt or arrange a separately scoped correction before claiming security approval.

Reference max_bytes is applied after full file read and not on line-range output; discovery head limits count lines rather than bytes, and store reindex caches parsed entries even when not migrated. Do not equate these display bounds with bounded ingestion or lazy memory. These are not additional closure features to implement.

Session torn-tail test intentionally accepts a complete-JSON unsupported tail (F08). Verification tests substitute transport errors for process nonzero status (F05). Task tests do not cover resumed-running state (F18). Header timestamp function returns epoch milliseconds despite ISO-8601 documentation. Retain truthful baseline caveats; do not weaken tests or fold fixes into this integration.

integration_blockers.detail: Parent must combine separately reviewed LLM/catalog, tools/LSP and CLI/TUI composition closures; this slice is not independently buildable on HEAD. Notice exhaustive matches and ext fixture are concrete cross-crate requirements.

Partial selections are mandatory: contracts lib and registry exclude unrelated exports/sorting, config excluded absent editor decision. Whole-file staging of these paths violates this proposed allowlist.

No isolated allowlisted candidate has been compiled/tested. Prior 794-test WT run cannot certify a hunk-minimized candidate. Later parent validation must use exact candidate including real and offline features, required manifests/lockfile from other reviewers.

Full security/quality approval is withheld because existing baseline defects remain and Unicode delimiter indexing risk was identified. For baseline-only integration, document explicit disposition rather than silently claiming passed=true; fixes are outside this delegated task.
